thesis: Classic models embody useful assumptions and trade accuracy, explanation and sensitivity to data in different ways.
role: Explain the toolbox without reducing machine learning to deep networks.

ideas.statement: Linear regression fits weighted sums, while logistic regression transforms a score into a category probability; feature engineering can expose nonlinear structure.
Nearest neighbors compare stored examples; trees learn informative questions; forests average varied trees while boosting successively corrects errors.
Alternative tools include margins and kernels, Bayesian updates, density and hierarchical clustering, uncertainty-aware regression and partial supervision.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: The ruler on springs illustrates squared error; editors correcting earlier drafts illustrate boosting.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: A shared bias in the data survives ensembling, and correlation is not causation.

audit.notes: Entire assigned segment reviewed; scope and qualifications preserved. Duplicate contents and publication metadata are not ranked as ideas.
